# Ultra_Small_World_Networks

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Dynamical systems on networks with extremely short average path lengths, approaching the theoretical minimum for connectivity. Critical for designing low-latency, high-efficiency interconnect topologies in TCC, where minimal hops reduce communication overhead.
